## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 `sql-driver.ts` 里「更新时 `updated_at` 列是推定存在的,若该表其实没有这一列就每表一次地降级重试」这一个机制(`updateWithPresumedTimestamp` 与它询问数据库列是否存在的 `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` 两个方法体)原样搬进新建的 `sql-driver-presumed-timestamp.ts`;类上的方法、文档注释和签名全部保留,只把方法体转交过去,宿主接口 `PresumedTimestampHost` 恰好列出方法体读的 7 个成员。
- **为什么改**:#25521 拆分超大文件的第 21 刀;第 20 刀合入后重新测量,这是系列里最后一个收益超过 −30 行的单一机制,`sql-driver.ts` 减少 34 行。本刀之后余下的每个机制都在 −29 行或以内,或被系列限制钉住,席位可据此收束该系列。
- **风险与回滚**:纯搬移,无行为变化;三个 SQL 驱动的测试两端逐条一致,公开类型声明哈希不变,60 条探针读数两端除一条外一致(两个桩方法不再是 `AsyncFunction`,返回值仍是同一个 Promise,系列既有形态)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`sql-driver-presumed-timestamp.ts`(头注释、`PresumedTimestampHost`、两个函数体);`sql-driver.ts` 中这两个方法的转交桩;`sql-driver.ts` 新增的 3 行 import。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-24835-update-leaves-caller-data.test.ts src/sql-driver-11176-bulk-and-merge-updated-at.test.ts`,预期全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Cut 21 of the `sql-driver.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6463125783`. Cut 20 (#27127) merged first, as `80064b2556`; this cut opens with a fresh seam table taken on `origin/main` `1900c02cb` (below) and takes the one remaining area that is a single mechanism, moves cleanly and pays more than -30: **the presumed-timestamp update**. The bodies of `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` and `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` move unedited into a **new** seam module, `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-presumed-timestamp.ts`, through its host `PresumedTimestampHost`.

`updateWithPresumedTimestamp` issues an UPDATE whose `updated_at` stamp is a presumption (a managed object registered without DDL), fenced in a savepoint inside a caller transaction, and, if the write fails, asks the database whether the column is there; an `absent` answer settles the table, logs one warning and re-issues the caller's payload without the stamp. `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` is that question: a `columnInfo()` catalog read on the physical table, `null` when it cannot be answered. Its only caller is `updateWithPresumedTimestamp`, so the two are one mechanism. The two callers of the update, `update` and `updateMany`, stay in the class and still hand it the `issue` callback that owns the WHERE and the tenant scope.

**Why a new module.** No existing seam module holds anything about update stamping; the nearest (`sql-driver-autonumber.ts`) only shares `attemptWithoutPoisoning`, which stays on the class. The new module imports `sql-driver.ts` for a type only (`import type { SqlDriver }`), plus `import type` of `Knex` and `DriverOptions`, so it adds no evaluation cycle, and the bodies read no module-level declaration, so nothing gains `export` and nothing else moves.

**`PresumedTimestampHost`** lists exactly the seven members the bodies read, each typed as the class member (`SqlDriver['NAME']`): the `knex`, `logger`, `physicalTableByObject`, `physicalSchemaByObject` and `updatedAtColumnState` fields (as getters), and the protected `attemptWithoutPoisoning` and `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` methods (as late-bound closures). So `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` still reaches `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` through the driver: a subclass override or an instance spy of it is still the one called (probe readings 4 and 5).

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for the seat to close the series. There is no `docs/adr/**` edit, no `packages/spec/**` edit, no anchor entry change, no gate edit, no test edit and no new gate. Branch `claude/project-thread-ta8bkd` (the platform assigned it to this card thread, as the claim records). The move is one commit, `0379b7673`, on `1900c02cb`.

**Net line count (the seat's rule).** `sql-driver.ts` goes from 18,367 lines to 18,333: **-34**.

- **Out:** the two bodies, 57 lines (16 + 41).
- **In:** the two stub bodies, 10 lines each, and 3 import lines (a 2-line comment and the `./sql-driver-presumed-timestamp.js` import, placed after cut 20's seam import).
- `sql-driver-presumed-timestamp.ts` is new: 130 lines (a 42-line header, three type imports, the 16-line host and the two functions with their one-line docblocks).

**Path readers.** No test, script, doc, ADR or anchor entry reads either body by path, so none is migrated. `sql-driver-11176-bulk-and-merge-updated-at.test.ts` names `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` in a comment, still true: the method is still on the class.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** I read the file list of every open PR on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the start (27 open, after #27127 merged) and again before opening this one (19 open). None touches `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**`.

### Pricing the areas

Eligibility is as cuts 11-20 defined it: an annotated return type or not public; no `getBuilder`, `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(`, private-static, `super`, bare-`this` or `this`-write site; not `insertOnlyUpsertColumns`; not a member pinned in place (`createColumn`, `applyFilterCondition`, `formatInput`/`formatOutput`, `initObjects`, `ensureShardTable`, `computeTenantField`, `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`/`migrateMysqlTimeColumns`, `compileFilters`). Each area is priced per mechanism (cut 19's correction), as its stubs minus its bodies, then net of its import edits. The leading row was measured by running the move script on a scratch copy of the file; the rest are the stub estimate (a stub costs 4 lines, +2 per field read, +1 per method read).

## Why

### Why this area, as one area

- **One mechanism.** One question, "issue this UPDATE with a presumed `updated_at` and recover once if the column is not there", and its one sub-question, "does the physical table carry `updated_at`". Their callers and every member they read stay in the class.
- **It is the last single mechanism over -30.** -34 measured; the next is -29 (`presentReadValue`).
- **No series limit is touched.** Neither body builds through `getBuilder`: `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` reads the table's catalog with `columnInfo()` on Knex directly (the same kind of read `check:tenant-chokepoint`'s header names for `listPhysicalColumns`, with no rows to scope), and `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` builds nothing itself (the caller's `issue` callback builds and scopes the statement, and stays in `update` / `updateMany`). Neither body reads a static, has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, uses `super` or bare `this`, or assigns to `this` (`updatedAtColumnState.set(…)` mutates the map the getter returns, the same map). Both methods are protected with annotated return types (a `Promise` of `boolean | null`, and of `number`). `check:tenant-chokepoint`'s D8 predicates, measured with its own `nullArmsOf`: **4 at base and 4 at head**, all in `sql-driver.ts`, 0 in the moved bodies and 0 in the module.
- **Durability gate.** `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence`'s `catch` returns `null` and calls no `logDurabilityFailure`; neither member appears in `check:durability-log-level --list` at base. `check:durability-log-level --list` prints 165 lines at both ends, identical except that two `runWideningAlters` seams in `sql-driver.ts` move 34 lines up and `logDurabilityFailure`'s line 3 down (the import).
- **Subclasses and spies.** `TursoDriver` and `SqliteWasmDriver` override neither method nor a member they read (`SqliteWasmDriver` assigns `this.logger` in its constructor; the host reads `logger` through a getter at call time). The tests that reach these paths (`sql-driver-24835-update-leaves-caller-data.test.ts`, `sql-driver-11176-bulk-and-merge-updated-at.test.ts`) call `update` / `updateMany` or read `updatedAtStampIsPresumed` / `updatedAtColumnState` through `(driver as any)`; all still reach the class.
- **Path readers, screened.** No script, test, doc or ADR names either member by a `sql-driver.ts#…` pointer or a `sql-driver.ts::…` key, and no `scripts/adr-anchors/**` record names them or the presumed stamp.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1-20 apply it)

- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, byte-identical except that the stub drops `async` (it returns the moved async function's promise, as every earlier async stub in this file does, for example cut 11's autonumber stubs). Its body is now one host literal plus `NAME.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25521 cut 21]`. The stub cannot throw before the call, so a failure is still a rejected promise (probe readings 4 and 6).
- The fields go as GETTERS that read the driver at call time, and the methods as closures that call them on the driver at call time. So a subclass override or an instance spy is still the one the body reaches, and a `knex` or `logger` replaced after construction is the one read (probe readings 3, 4, 5).
- **Comments.** The module header says what moved, what stayed and how the bodies reach the class. The `sql-driver.ts` import comment names cut 21 in 2 lines. Neither cites an `ADR-NNNN` letter. The methods' docblocks (`[commit 479fba50d]` tags, no ADR letter) stay in `sql-driver.ts`.
- **How the move was made.** A script produced it from the source text; nothing was retyped. Each body line is re-indented two columns; no body line starts inside a template literal.

## Verification

### ADR anchors

- **The count.** `check:adr-anchors` counts **1900** decision-letter citations at base `1900c02cb` (a clean detached worktree) and **1900** at the move commit, over 91 anchored files at both ends; the two outputs are byte-identical. Both runs exit 0.
- **After `main` moved.** `main` moved 11 commits under the cut (to `3346da26df`, none in `packages/drivers/**`). Its tip counts **1900** letters (a clean detached worktree), and so does a local, unpushed merge of the move commit with it; both exit 0. I did not merge `main` into this branch: `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the head with it exits 0, so the tree is not stale.
- **Why equal.** No comment inside the moved bodies or the new header cites a decision letter, and the module is not anchored.
- **No entry needs a new home.** No anchor entry names the moved members. `check:adr-symbol-anchors` output is byte-identical at both ends.

### The published `.d.ts` does not change

This is measured under the series bar (ruling `6348891160`, item 1).

- **How each end was built.** `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/driver-sql --force` at each end, against the same dependency tree. The base leg writes base `sql-driver.ts` into this worktree and removes the new module, under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap that restores HEAD. The restore is proved by the HEAD blob hashes, an empty `git diff HEAD` and 0 status entries (`RESTORE-OK 89b6a55f6a… 28c6eab163…`).
- **The hashes.** The raw sha256 of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` is the same at base and at the move commit: `0f33bf3febaac3c7aa96f68a4226d752766b8203ab7acade523b69f9aaa44d74` (unchanged since cut 8); `cmp` exit 0. These two are the dist's only declaration files (no chunk), so the declaration-reorder bar of ruling `6441032442` does not come into play.
- **Positive control.** I dropped `protected` from `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` in a copy of the head `index.d.ts` (1 hit, then 0). The copy hashes to `0f3d0fcb2cc407bc147f3506f3ada0018db26ad0a581c40e6a62355bb73222ab`, with `cmp` exit 1.
- **Export lists.** CJS `require` of each dist gives 59 names (sha1 `05757ce5ae` at both ends); the ESM namespace of `index.mjs` gives the same 59 at both ends (sha1 `05757ce5ae`). Neither moved function nor `PresumedTimestampHost` is among them.
- **The head dist carries the move.** `.call(host` sites in `index.mjs` go from 70 at base to 72 at head (the two stubs).

### Move-only proof

The proof compares TypeScript compiler AST leaf tokens (JSDoc nodes skipped), base `1900c02cb` against the move commit `0379b7673`. It is a scratch script and is not committed.

| Moved body | Body tokens | Comments | Parameter tokens less `this` | Return type tokens | Body lines |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` | 125 | 2 | 9 | 6 | 16 |
| `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` | 262 | 0 | 38 | 4 | 41 |

- **The moved bodies.** 0 tokens differ and every comment is identical. Each body line is the base line less two leading spaces. Both are `async` at both ends (the module functions carry it).
- **The stubs.** Leading trivia (the docblock), modifiers other than `async`, and the signature are identical to base.
- **The class.** It has 350 members at both ends, in the same order, and the 348 unmoved members are byte-identical, trivia included.
- **Top level of `sql-driver.ts`.** 180 of 181 base statements are byte-identical; the other is the class. The head adds one statement, the new import (its 2-line comment is its leading trivia).
- **Result.** `PROOF OK`, exit 0.
- **Negative control.** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, I changed `if (columns.length === 0) return null;` to `=== 1` in the module (anchor 1 hit, then 0, blob `28c6eab163` to `8b1b9275bb`, checked on disk). The proof then reports `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` as differing (body), prints `PROOF FAILED`, and exits 1. The restore was proved (blob `28c6eab163` equals HEAD, empty `git diff HEAD`, 0 status entries).

### Tests

Each end ran under one `os-verify-lock` hold, after building that end's driver-sql dist. I compared the vitest JSON per test name and status, base `1900c02cb` against the move commit `0379b7673`. Every part's exit code was captured on its own (build, probe, three suites: all 0 at both legs).

| `@objectstack/driver-sql` | 4061 (3847 passed, 214 skipped; 248 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-turso`, against that end's built driver-sql dist | 2526 (2492 passed, 34 skipped; 95 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` | 746 (746 passed; 39 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |

- **Type check and lint.** `tsc --noEmit -p .` in driver-sql exits 0 on the move commit. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-sql` exits 0 (driver-sql has no `lint` script of its own).
- **Late-binding probe.** A scratch script, not committed. It runs node against each end's built dist (real in-memory SQLite tables) and prints 60 readings, each with the result or the error's class, message and top stack frame:
  1. `update()` on a presumed table without and with a physical `updated_at`, twice each (the recovery, the warning, the `absent` / `present` settling, then the settled path);
  2. `update()` inside a caller transaction (the savepoint fence; the transaction is still usable afterwards) and `updateMany()` outside and inside one;
  3. `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` directly: present, absent, a missing table, a `physicalTableByObject` alias, a `physicalSchemaByObject` schema, on a transaction, a throwing `columnInfo()` and an empty one (`knex` replaced on the instance), then `knex` restored;
  4. `updateWithPresumedTimestamp` directly with fake `issue` callbacks over every branch (absent / unknown / present answers, with and without a transaction), with an instance spy on `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` and on `attemptWithoutPoisoning` (both reached, arguments recorded), the caller's payload left intact, and `logger` and `updatedAtColumnState` replaced on the instance (the replacements are the ones read);
  5. SUBCLASS overrides of `resolveUpdatedAtColumnPresence` (answering `false`, then `null`) and of `attemptWithoutPoisoning`, reached from `update()`;
  6. a non-column failure rethrown unchanged, and a PostgreSQL driver whose server is unreachable (`null`);
  7. the two methods' shape on the prototype (type, arity, constructor name).
- **Probe result.** 59 of the 60 readings are identical. The other is reading 7: the two stubs' constructor name is `Function` at head where it was `AsyncFunction` at base (type `function` and arity 2 / 4 identical). That is the stub dropping `async`, as every earlier async stub of this series does; no test, consumer or `.d.ts` reads it.
- **Not run.** No ablation, because no tested behaviour changed.
- **`test:repo`.** Not run locally; it is CI's run on this PR.

### Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **48** families for this diff (the same 48 cuts 17-20 derived). I ran each one on its own and captured its exit code before any pipe, after a full `pnpm build` of the move commit (116 of 116 tasks).

- **Move commit `0379b7673`: 48 run, all 48 exit 0.** `--ran` reconciles: `48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 48 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`, exit 0. (I fetched the pinned fixture commit of `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` into this shallow clone first.)
- **Hand gates, all exit 0:** `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`, `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`, `eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-sql`, `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list`.
